conf.description: entra-id audit dataset, api-pull format: Cribl REST Collector against the Log Analytics Query API (AuditLogs table), column-rename pipeline into logs-azure.auditlogs. InitiatedBy and TargetResources arrive as parsed dynamic columns, so sub-field extraction is a property read, not a JSON decode. Event time is written to _time (epoch seconds) rather than a literal '@timestamp' field, which Cribl's property-accessor parser rejects.

conf.comment: entra-id / audit / api-pull: one JS object per row, PascalCase columns, InitiatedBy/TargetResources/AdditionalDetails already parsed dynamics (no decode step needed). TargetResources is preserved as a single nested array under azure.auditlogs.properties.target_resources rather than exploded per sub-attribute, since it is an unbounded heterogeneous array and Cribl eval cannot rename per-element keys without changing event cardinality -- the map recommends mapping it nested anyway. user.target.name/id and the AdditionalDetails User-Agent lift use a bounded ternary over the first 3 (resp. 5) entries instead of .find(), because Cribl's eval forbids function/arrow declarations (confirmed against this instance: 'cannot have nested scopes' / 'cannot have any declarations'). AADTenantId is the Entra tenant, not TenantId (workspace GUID). ActivityDateTime is written to _time (epoch seconds), not a literal '@timestamp' field, which this instance's property-accessor parser rejects.
